description: Inland Revenue Department - Value added Tax Act No. 14 of 2002 Conditions and specifications to operate Risk based Refund Scheme
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes a new regulatory framework for the Risk Based Refund Scheme under the Value Added Tax Act. It creates legal procedures, compliance requirements, and regulatory specifications for VAT refund processing, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette. The content focuses on statutory implementation rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
